{{Quote|Bold, but I'd expect no less from the best commander to ever come out of the Mykapo system.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
'''Jun Sato''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who [[Commander|commanded]] the [[Phoenix Cell]], a rebel cell that operated against the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]]. He and his cell, which included a group of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing starfighters]] known as [[Phoenix Squadron]], were affiliated with the larger rebel movement operated by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]. At the recommendation of Senator Organa, Sato welcomed the [[Spectres]] into his fleet, and the two cells fought side by side in a number of engagements. Sato lost his command ship, ''[[Phoenix Home]]'', after it was [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (4 BBY)|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], after which Sato transferred his command to the [[CR90 corvette]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']] and later the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] ''[[Phoenix Nest]]''.

Commander Sato and [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] continued leading the Phoenix Squadron in the period between [[3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]]. During this time, Sato saw action in numerous missions and skirmishes against the Empire. Phoenix Squadron later established a base called [[Chopper Base]] on the planet [[Atollon]]. He reunited with his nephew [[Mart Mattin]] during the [[Skirmish over Mykapo|skirmish]] above [[Mykapo]]. After Phoenix Squadron joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Sato's forces joined forces with [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group]] for a planned assault on [[Lothal]]. However, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] learned of their plans and attacked Atollon. Sato sacrificed his life during the [[Battle of Atollon]] in order to allow [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] to escape and seek help, killing Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]] in the process.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I first came to your world as a young man. I'd been accepted as a student into your prestigious crystal-cutting school. It was a dream come true. Isobe is a lot of things, but welcoming to outsiders is not one of them. That was made that very clear to me. Your daughter ''Althea'' was the only one who ever showed me kindness. I knew that it could never be, but... I couldn't help but love her.|Jun Sato|<ref name="Never Far Behind" />}}
[[File:Xenophobic_Sephi.jpg|thumb|left|154px|Isobe's natives were hostile to Sato.]]
Jun Sato was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> from the [[planet]] [[Mykapo]].<ref name="Mykapo Databank" /> As a young man, he was offered a spot in a [[crystal]] [[Smuggler|smuggling]] ring, which he took for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. As a cover, he got himself accepted into the prestigious crystal processing school of the planet [[Isobe]], in the [[Thustra system]]. When most natives were [[Xenophobia|hostile]] and even violent to him, Sato found comfort and support with [[Princess]] [[Althea]], daughter of the planetary leader [[Lord]] [[Hallux]], who would even tend to his wounds. Eventually, Sato was caught red-handed smuggling stolen crystals. Although he defended himself that night in front of Lord Hallux, his son [[Thelan]] and a very dismayed Althea, Sato was found guilty of the charge and banished from Isobe for the rest of his life, on pain of death. Because of his shame and pride, Sato never tried to contact Althea again after his banishment, although there was much he wanted to tell her.<ref name="Never Far Behind" />

At some point before joining the Rebellion, Sato was part of [[Mykapo system planetary defense forces|Mykapo's planetary defense forces]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion VG" /> 

===Age of the Empire===
====Commanding the Phoenix Cell====
By [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> [[Commander]] Sato led the [[Phoenix Cell]] during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]]. He and his forces were part of the larger rebel movement<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> that was loosely organized by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]], Senator [[Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila]], and Commander [[Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="Organa Databank">{{Databank|bail-organa|Bail Organa}}</ref> the latter of whom operated as a rebel informant under the codename "[[Fulcrum]]."<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy">{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}}</ref> He had a [[Sato|brother]] and a nephew named [[Mart Mattin]] who were members of a small Mykapo-based rebel cell called [[Iron Squadron]]. At some unknown point, Sato lost contact with them after Imperial forces attacked and killed his brother. However, Mattin survived and took over leadership of the Iron Squadron.<ref name="Iron Squadron">{{Rebels|Iron Squadron (episode)}}</ref>

====The Siege of Lothal====
{{Quote|I believe it could be worth the risk.|Commander Jun Sato approves the Spectres' mission to assist Minister Maketh Tua on Lothal|<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />}}
Later, Commander Tano led forces<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy" /> from the Phoenix cell<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> to the assistance of the [[Spectres]], who mounted a [[Action at Mustafar|mission]] to rescue their captive leader, the [[Jedi]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] custody over the [[planet]] [[Mustafar]].<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy" /> After the rescue, Sato welcomed the Spectres into his fleet, after they were highly recommended by Senator Organa and Commander Tano.<ref name="Sato Databank" />

[[File:Maketh_Tua_contacts_the_rebels.png|thumb|right|300px|After Maketh Tua contacts the rebels, Commander Sato authorizes a mission to assist her.]]
As part of the rebel fleet, the Spectres, aboard their ship the ''[[Ghost]]'', carried out a number of attacks against Imperial targets, securing [[fuel]] for ''Phoenix Home'' and the [[CR90 corvette]]s that it led. After [[Mission to steal Imperial shield generators|one such attack]], in which the Spectres led the Phoenix cell's group of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing fighters]], known as [[Phoenix Squadron]], in an attempt to steal Imperial [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]], Sato commended the ''Ghost'' crew for their work. [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] of the ''Ghost'' regretted being unable to secure the shield generators for the fleet, but they had secured additional fuel to maintain Phoenix operations. It was then that the crew's [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]], nicknamed "Chopper," arrived in the ''Phoenix Home'' command center carrying a message from Lothal. The transmission was from [[Maketh Tua]], a [[minister]] in Lothal's Imperial government, who requested that the rebels help her defect from the Empire in exchange for valuable intelligence; the secrets she was willing to share included the names of rebel sympathizers on Lothal and nearby worlds, as well as the true reason for the Empire's presence on Lothal. Commander Sato believed that the [[Mission to Lothal (4 BBY)|mission]] was worth the risk and allowed the ''Ghost'' crew to return to Lothal to help Minister Tua.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />

The rebels' return to their former world led to the [[Siege of Lothal]], as [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], pursued the rebels on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet. The rebels escaped Lothal aboard a stolen [[Sentinel-class landing craft|shuttle]] after the Empire assassinated Tua, implicating the rebels in the crime, and they returned to ''Phoenix Home''. Once there, they realized that the Empire had placed a tracking device on the shuttle. Their warning to Commander Sato came too late, however, as Darth Vader [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (4 BBY)|arrived]] alone in his [[TIE Advanced x1]] [[starfighter]]. Sato ordered Phoenix Squadron to engage the Dark Lord, but Vader was the superior [[pilot]] and destroyed most of the squadron. Vader's attack led to ''Phoenix Home'' suffering critical damage and, despite the suggestions of Captain Syndulla—who, along with her crew had boarded the ''Ghost'' to engage Vader—Sato at first refused to abandon the command ship. Once it was apparent that ''Phoenix Home'' was lost, Commander Sato changed his mind and ordered an evacuation. He and his crew [[Escape pod|escaped]] as a fleet of [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]] jumped into the area, and the ''Ghost'' provided enough of a diversion so the crew could board the rest of the fleet and jump into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />

====Regrouping====
{{Quote|The destruction of our command ship has severely limited our ability to fight the Empire in this sector.|Commander Jun Sato on the loss of ''Phoenix Home''|<ref name="The Lost Commanders">{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}}</ref>}}
Though the Phoenix cell suffered a significant defeat at the hands of Darth Vader, Sato and his crew survived, and the fleet rendezvoused at a location they had dubbed as Safe Haven.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> As a result of the loss of ''Phoenix Home'', Sato transferred his command to the [[CR90 corvette]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']],<ref name="Sato Databank" /> though he felt that it hampered the fleet's ability to fight the Empire. [[Ezra Bridger]] then suggested that they find a place to hide. Though Sato agreed with the young Jedi's suggestion, everyone argued that they don't know of a secure location to put up a base of operations. Tano then spoke up, claiming to know a [[Rex|friend]] who knew the locations of bases in the Outer Rim that would suit their purpose, and sent the ''Ghost'' crew to make contact.<ref name="The Lost Commanders" /> The crew eventually returned with Tano's friend, [[clone trooper]] Rex, who agreed to join the rebels.<ref name="Relics">{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}}</ref>

====Assisting Rinn====
{{Quote|As we speak, the frozen planet of Rinn is facing an energy crisis. When their supply of fuel cells is gone, the settlements will not be able to power the heaters they need to survive.|Commander Jun Sato on Rinn's crisis|<ref name="BOTBH">{{Rebels|Brothers of the Broken Horn}}</ref>}}
When the planet [[Rinn]] faced an energy crisis, Sato ordered the Spectres to see if they could find any [[fuel cell]]s on [[Garel]] to take to Rinn.<ref name="BOTBH" />

====Assisting the people of Ibaar====
Sometime later, Sato lent Phoenix Squadron and the CR90 corvette [[Transport One]] to a mission that involved delivering supplies to the famished people of the planet [[Ibaar]], which had been decimated by an Imperial [[Blockade of Ibaar|blockade]]. The initial attempt to break the blockade failed, as Transport 1, which was carrying the supplies, was destroyed. In addition, [[Phoenix Leader (Ibaar)|Phoenix Leader]] of Phoenix Squadron was killed during the combat. The survivors of the mission, including the crew of the ''Ghost'', rendezvoused with the rest of the rebel fleet and met with Sato to discuss their options in regards to Ibaar. Rex suggested that they seek out an engineer named [[Quarrie]], who had an [[Prototype B6|experimental starfighter]] on hand that could change the course of the growing conflict. However, Quarrie happened to be located on the planet [[Shantipole]]. Two Phoenix Squadron pilots voiced their concerns for the plan, as Shantipole was known to be a "one way trip" for unskilled pilots. In response, ''Ghost'' crewmember and ex-[[Jedi]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] volunteered Captain Syndulla to go on the mission, as she was the rebels' best pilot. Sato agreed to the plan, and Syndulla, along with two of her other crew members, departed for Shantipole. However, Jarrus and Bridger stayed behind to use the ''Ghost'' for a second run against the blockade, which would happen if Syndulla was deemed to be taking too long.<ref name="Wings">{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}}</ref>

[[File:Jun_Sato_and_Quarrie.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Sato informed Quarrie of Organa's plan to further production of Quarrie's starfighters.]]
After waiting for Syndulla's return, Sato believed that enough time had passed, and loaded the ''Ghost'' with Ibaar's supplies. Rebel forces clashed again with the blockade. Despite the rebels' efforts, the Imperial vessels began to pin the rebel ships together. However, Syndulla finally returned behind the controls of Quarrie's experimental fighter and led the rebels to victory. After departing Ibaar, Sato was introduced to Quarrie, who had come along to join the rebels. Sato had been informed by Senator Organa that a friendly manufacturer had agreed to build more of Quarrie's fighters to support the growing rebellion. Recognizing Syndulla's piloting expertise, he promoted her as the next [[Phoenix Leader]].<ref name="Wings" />

====Escaping the Interdictor====
{{Quote|Ah, yes. I am familiar with your activities in this sector. I suspected if we captured even one rebel ship, others would race to the rescue. But I dared not hope we'd capture someone as significant as you.|Admiral Brom Titus, to Jun Sato|<ref name="Stealth Strike">{{Rebels|Stealth Strike}}</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_cruiser_crashes_into_the_Interdictor.png|thumb|right|300px|Sato watching the destruction of the Interdictor.]]
Following the disappearance of a rebel patrol in the [[Del Zennis system]], Jun Sato and the young Jedi rebel [[Ezra Bridger]] traveled on his [[CR90 corvette]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']] to investigate. Commander Sato had taken Bridger aboard for the mission at the recommendation of Hera Syndulla. While traveling through [[hyperspace]], Bridger sensed a disturbance in [[the Force]]. Immediately, the corvette was pulled out of hyperspace and cornered by an [[Interdictor (Interdictor-class)|Imperial Interdictor]], a new prototype warship equipped with [[gravity well projector]]s. Before the ship's power systems shut down, Sato managed to send a distress transmission that was picked up by the crew of the ''[[Ghost]]''.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

Sato's corvette was then pulled into the ventral hangar of the Interdictor and boarded by Imperial forces. Commander Sato and Bridger were then brought before the ship's commanding officer, [[Admiral]] [[Brom Titus]]. Sato tried to convince Titus that he and his crew were members of the [[Corporate Alliance]]. However, this tactic failed since Titus quickly recognized his prisoners as Commander Sato and Ezra Bridger respectively. Knowing that his colleague, the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] agent Kallus, was looking for Bridger, he ordered his men to secure the prisoners.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

Commander Sato and his crew were confined in a detention cell while Bridger was led by three [[stormtrooper]]s to a secure cell. However, Bridger managed to escape and link up with a rescue mission sent by Phoenix Leader Hera Syndulla. This rescue mission consisted of the Jedi Kanan Jarrus, the former clone trooper Rex, and the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]]. While Chopper and Bridger went to sabotage the Interdictor's gravity well projectors, Jarrus and Rex managed to rescue Sato and his crew from their detention cell. Together, they made their way back to Sato's CR90 corvette but were pursued by stormtroopers.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

During the fighting, Rex stayed behind to hold off the stormtroopers and was captured. Shortly later, they were rejoined by Bridger and Chopper. The young Jedi soon took the lead as he bravely fought against a squad of stormtroopers, at which Sato urged his crew to follow Bridger's lead. Sato and the other rebels then managed to board the CR90 corvette while Jarrus went back to rescue Rex. After Jarrus and Rex escaped the Interdictor in an [[escape pod]], Commander Sato prepared to make a jump into hyperspace. However, they were pulled out of hyperspace again by the Interdictor, which had been joined by two [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]]. Fortunately for Sato and the rebels, Chopper had sabotaged the Interdictor's gravity well projectors; causing the light cruisers to collide with the Interdictor. Commander Sato and his ship then managed to escape into hyperspace. Grateful to his rescuers, Sato thanked Jarrus, Rex, and Bridger for rescuing him and his crew.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

====Escape from Garel====
Due to an accidental leak by Ezra Bridger on [[Takobo]], the [[Seventh Sister]] and the [[Fifth Brother]] learned that the Phoenix rebel cell was hiding on Garel. The two Inquisitors informed their Imperial colleagues [[Agent]] Kallus and [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]], who sent an Imperial fleet from Lothal to attack [[Garel City]]. During the [[Battle of Garel|escape]], Sato was with the former Clone Captain Rex when the ''Liberator'' was caught in the [[tractor beam]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless]]'', Konstantine's ship. However, Phoenix Leader Syndulla managed to free Sato and Rex by using the ''[[Ghost]]'' to ram into the Star Destroyer's [[tractor beam projector]]. This enabled Commander Sato and the remaining ships to escape into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Legends">{{Rebels|Legacy (episode)}}</ref>

====Trouble on Concord Dawn====
[[File:Concord_Dawn_planning.png|thumb|left|300px|Commander Sato (far left) discussing the Concord Dawn mission with his fellow rebels.]]
Commander Sato attended a meeting with several other rebels including the former Clone Captain Rex and the crew of the ''Ghost'' to discuss their options for opening a new [[hyperspace]] route to the [[Lothal sector]]. The Galactic Empire was hunting down rebel forces throughout the Outer Rim. Wren suggested the [[Concord Dawn system]], which was home to a [[Mandalorian]] colony known as the [[Journeyman Protector|Protectors]]. Due to the warlike and militant nature of the Mandalorians, Commander Sato believed that diplomacy would not work and recommended sending a military force to Concord Dawn. However, Wren and Syndulla managed to convince Commander Sato and the other rebels to send a diplomatic mission to obtain safe passage from the Protectors. Despite his reservations, Sato allowed Syndulla and Wren to proceed with their mission.<ref name="The Protector of Concord Dawn">{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}}</ref>

Sato's fears were proven when Syndulla's mission was [[Dogfight over Concord Dawn|attacked]] above [[Concord Dawn]] by the Protectors' [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang fighters]]. The Protectors' leader [[Fenn Rau]] had allied his people with the Empire and refused to negotiate with the rebels. Several [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s were destroyed during the dogfight and Syndulla was seriously wounded. Sato was later present during a debriefing with Wren, Jarrus, Rex, and the other crew of the ''Ghost'', minus Syndulla. With diplomacy no longer an option, Sato authorized a [[Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|sabotage mission]] by Jarrus to destroy the Protectors' Fang starfighters, which were housed at a [[Protectors Camp|base]] on the [[third moon of Concord Dawn]]. This mission was a success and the rebels also succeeded in capturing Fenn Rau, who agreed to allow the rebels safe passage through the Concord Dawn system in return for keeping his capture a secret from the Empire.<ref name="The Protector of Concord Dawn" />

====Mission to Ryloth====
Following the loss of one A-wing starfighter during one of Phoenix Squadron's missions, the Phoenix rebels needed a place to land and protect their remaining starfighters. In response, Sato suggested that Syndulla and Jarrus steal an Imperial [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] that had been orbiting [[Ryloth]], the [[Twi'lek]] homeworld. Hera Syndulla and the Spectres made contact with the [[Twi'lek Resistance]] and their leader [[Cham Syndulla]], her father. Together, the two rebel factions hatched a plan to steal the carrier. However, the [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission]] was complicated by Cham's own agenda to destroy the carrier. After a struggle with both Cham's resistance fighters and Imperial reinforcements, the Spectres managed to capture the fighter carrier for the rebellion.<ref name="Homecoming">{{Rebels|Homecoming}}</ref>

====Chopper Base====
Commander Sato convened a meeting aboard his new flagship, the former Imperial fighter carrier, to discuss the rebel plans to establish a base in the [[Yost system]]. By cross-referencing Republic and [[Lasat]] star charts, the friend of Sabine [[Ketsu Onyo]] had identified [[Berzite's moon]] as a prospective location for a rebel base. With the fighter carrier low on fuel, Wren recommended raiding the Imperial [[fuel]] depot on [[Horizon Base]]. Using this information, Sato sanctioned a [[Heist at Horizon Base|mission]] by the crew of the ''Ghost'' to steal the fuel.<ref name="The Forgotten Droid">{{Rebels|The Forgotten Droid}}</ref>

Shorty later, the rebel fleet was attacked by Imperial forces under Admiral Konstantine. After the ''Ghost'' landed on the fighter-carrier with the fuel supplies, Sato prepared the fleet to depart for the Yost system. However, Syndulla received information from [[C1-10P|Chopper]] and the Imperial [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]] that the Empire had set a trap there. After AP-5 instead transmitted the coordinates to [[Atollon]], a safe world lacking an Imperial presence, Sato and the rest of the fleet traveled there.<ref name="The Forgotten Droid" />

Following the discovery of Atollon, the Phoenix rebels established a new base called [[Chopper Base]], in honor of Chopper. Sato remained aboard the rebel fighter carrier while the crew of the ''Ghost'' traveled to the base to deliver a shipment of power generators. Despite encountering a nest of [[Krykna]], Phoenix Leader Syndulla managed to secure the base by erecting a perimeter fence of [[sensor beacon]]s around it which deterred the Krykna. This allowed the rebels to protect their base on Atollon.<ref name="Mystery">{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}}</ref>

====Malachor====
Sato was later present when Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger returned from their [[Mission to Malachor|mission]] to [[Malachor]]. He, the other Spectres, Rex, and the [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]] watched as a blinded Jarrus embraced Syndulla. He later watched as a despondent Bridger emerged from the starship without the rebel operative and former Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano]], who had presumably died on Malachor.<ref name="Twilight">{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}}</ref>

====Reklam Station====
{{Quote|It seems Commander Bridger's recon mission has turned into a recovery operation.|Jun Sato to Hera Syndulla|<ref name="Steps">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Reclem_station_hologram.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Sato listens as Ohnaka provides information Reklam Station]]
About six months later,<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=episodes/steps-into-shadow-trivia-gallery|text="Steps Into Shadow" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> Sato attended a briefing with the Spectres, Rex, and the rescued pirate [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. The Spectres had [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|rescued]] Hondo from the [[Naraka prison|Imperial prison]] on the rocky planet of [[Naraka]]. As payment for his rescue, Hondo demanded that the rebels supply him with a [[hyperspace]]-capable smuggling vessel and a crew. Sato responded that the rebels would only pay him if his information was proven correct.<ref name="Steps" />

At Sato's prompting, Hondo revealed that the Imperials were operating a floating junkyard called [[Reklam Station]] in the planet [[Yarma]] where [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing starfighters]] were being scrapped. Sato agreed to Syndulla's request that the rebels undertake a [[Mission to Reklam Station|reconnaissance mission]] of Reklam Station. He also promoted Bridger to [[Lieutenant Commander]] due to his actions during Hondo's rescue and gave him command of the Reklam heist. After learning that Bridger had disobeyed orders and embarked on a recovery mission, Sato, Syndulla, and Jarrus traveled to Yarma and rescued Bridger's team and the stolen Y-wings.<ref name="Steps" />

====Rescuing defectors====
{{Quote|Welcome to the Rebellion.|Jun Sato to Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian|<ref name="Antilles Extraction">{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}}</ref>}}
[[File:FulcrumContact-TAA.png|thumb|left|220px|Sato shows the Spectres a transmission from Fulcrum]]
Later, Commander Sato chaired a briefing where he informed the Spectres of the [[Massacre near Teralov|destruction]] of a rebel convoy to [[Teralov]]. When Ezra expressed his despondency about the high casualties, Sato revealed that a rebel agent named "Fulcrum" had information that several cadets from the Imperial [[Skystrike Academy]] were planning to defect to the rebels. Sato was present when Hera assigned Sabine the [[Escape from Skystrike Academy|mission]]. After Sabine's return from the Skystrike Academy, Sato welcomed [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Derek Klivian]] to the rebellion.<ref name="Antilles Extraction" />

====Trouble on Concord Dawn====
{{Quote|We've lost communications with the Mandalorian base on Concord Dawn. Rebel leaders are concerned your Protectors are setting a trap for us.|Jun Sato to Fenn Rau|<ref name="ISC">{{Rebels|Imperial Supercommandos}}</ref>}}
After the rebellion lost contact with the Protectors on the [[Third moon of Concord Dawn|third moon]] of [[Concord Dawn]], Commander Sato and Phoenix Leader Hera Syndulla summoned the Protectors' leader [[Fenn Rau]] for a briefing in the war room aboard a [[CR90 corvette]]. While Sato thought that the Protectors were setting a trap, Rau assured him that this was not the case and suspected that something had gone wrong. Rau along with Sabine, Ezra, and Chopper then departed on a [[Second mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|recon mission]] to Concord Dawn to investigate. There, they discovered that the Imperial [[Viceroy]] and [[Governor]] [[Gar Saxon]]'s [[Imperial Super Commando]]s had wiped out the Protectors. As a result, Rau decided to join the rebellion.<ref name="ISC" />

====Evacuation of Mykapo====
{{Quote|Commander Jun Sato. I wondered what it would take to motivate your return to Mykapo.''"<br />"''And now you know, Admiral. Until we meet again.''"<br />"''Yes, until we meet again.|Grand Admiral Thrawn and Commander Jun Sato|<ref name="Iron Squadron" />}}
Later, Commander Sato received intelligence that Imperial forces were about to launch a crackdown on rebel sympathizers on [[Mykapo]]. Sato dispatched Phoenix Leader Syndulla and elements of Phoenix Squadron to evacuate the civilians. The rebels stumbled upon a skirmish between Mart's Iron Squadron and an Imperial advance patrol. After eliminating the Imperial patrol, Phoenix Squadron evacuated the dissidents. Hera also informed Commander Sato about Iron Squadron. Realizing that his nephew had survived, Jun pleaded with Hera and Kanan to bring him back safely. Hera, Ezra and Sabine tried to reason with Mart and his crew but they insisted on staying at Mykapo. Unable to reason with Mart, Hera returned to the rebel fleet.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

Ezra, Sabine, and Chopper stayed behind and managed to convince Mart's crew members [[Gooti Terez]], [[Jonner Jin]], and [[R3-A3]] to leave with them. However, Mart decided to face Imperial reinforcements led by Admiral Konstantine. When Mart's ship<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> ''[[Sato's Hammer]]'', a ship Sato used to own,<ref name="Sato's Hammer">{{Databank|satos-hammer|''Sato's Hammer''}}</ref> sustained damage, the Spectres and the other Iron Squadron members were forced to retreat without him. Hera later informed Jun via [[hologram]] about Mart's predicament and played a distress signal from the youth. Sato offered to travel to Mykapo to save his nephew but Hera convinced him that she and her crew would be able to handle the matter. Hera managed to rescue Mart and his ship. Sato and his forces arrived in time to attack Admiral Konstantine's ships.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

Sato ordered two A-wings to provide covering fire and reassured Mart that he had come to rescue him. After Mart damaged Konstantine's [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] with a bomb, the rebel ships flew past the derelict warship. Before they could jump into hyperspace, they narrowly collided with an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. Thrawn addressed Sato over the com and questioned why he had returned. Sato responded "now you know until we meet again." Thrawn vowed to meet him again and allowed Sato's forces to escape. Back at Chopper Base, Sato embraced Mart and thanked Hera and her crew for saving his nephew. He told Hera that he owed her and her crew a great debt.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

====Mission to Lothal armory factory====
Commander Sato stayed back at Chopper Base with Hera, Sabine, and Zeb while Ezra, Kanan, and Chopper undertook a mission to [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|infiltrate]] the [[Lothal]] [[Imperial Armory Complex]] with the help of [[Lothal resistance group|local rebels]] [[Ryder Azadi]] and [[Morad Sumar]]. Sato listened while Ryder informed Hera of the new Imperial commander Grand Admiral Thrawn, whom Sato had encountered earlier above Mykapo.<ref name="An Inside Man">{{Rebels|An Inside Man}}</ref>

====Mission to Geonosis====
{{Quote|Your intel concerning these matters, acquisition of a shield core and the rescue of Saw Gerrera makes the mission a profound success.|Jun Sato on the mission to Geonosis|<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />}}
Commander Sato appeared beside [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], a key ally of the rebellion, during a [[hologram]] conversation with the Spectres and Rex. Sato watched as Senator Organa briefed the rebels about [[Alliance High Command|Rebel Command]] losing contact with [[Saw Gerrera]] during a mission to investigate the apparent disappearance of the [[Geonosian]] species. Organa tasked the Spectres and Rex with rescuing Saw and recovering his data. Hera's team succeeded in rescuing Saw, befriending the Geonosian [[Klik-Klak]] and discovering irrefutable evidence that the Empire had perpetrated [[Sterilization of Geonosis|genocide]] against the Geonosian species. After Hera and her team reported their finding, Commander Sato described their mission as a success because they rescued Saw and obtained a [[deflector core]].<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

====Mon Mothma's speech====
Commander Sato and several other rebels including AP-5 and Rex were present at Chopper Base's command center when the former Imperial [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] delivered a [[HoloNet]] speech condemning the Empire and urging [[the galaxy]] to rise up in rebellion. This speech led to the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

===Alliance to Restore the Republic===
====Ezra's errant mission====
After Ezra heard [[Kanan Jarrus' holocron]] and the [[Sith holocron (Malachor)|Sith holocron]] from [[Malachor]] sending messages that hinted that the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was in danger from the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]], Commander Sato, Rex, and the Spectres attended a meeting to discuss Ezra's encounter. During the meeting, Hera told Ezra to remain on Atollon because they needed him for the upcoming strike on Lothal. However, Ezra disregarded Hera's orders and traveled with Chopper on a [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|mission]] to find Kenobi on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Twin Suns">{{Rebels|Twin Suns (episode)}}</ref>

====Last stand at Atollon====
{{Quote|Something's pulled them out of hyperspace.''"<br />"''If that is true, there will be no escape for us.|General Jan Dodonna and Commander Jun Sato on the Interdictor cruisers|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
[[File:JunSatosLastStand-ZeroHour.jpg|thumb|right|298px|Sato aboard the ''Phoenix Nest'' prior to his death.]]
Commander Sato was aboard the ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'' when [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group]] exited hyperspace to join Phoenix Squadron's planned assault on the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] factories on Lothal. After hailing Dodonna's warship ''[[Vanguard]]'', Sato attend a [[hologram]] conference with Captain Syndulla, General Dodonna, and [[Ryder Azadi]], their Lothal contact. Sato was present when a transmission was received from Fulcrum, informing the rebels that Grand Admiral Thrawn had uncovered the location of their base and was en route. Thrawn's fleet arrived moments later.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

During the [[Battle of Atollon]], ''Imperial-class'' Star Destroyers easily destroyed many of Phoenix Squadron's ships as well as most of General Dodonna's fleet. The rebels were unable to escape due to an [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor|active Interdictor cruiser]], commanded by Admiral Konstantine. In order to disable the ship, Sato ordered the crew of ''Phoenix Home'' to abandon ship and subsequently drove the craft into Konstantine's. Both Sato and Konstantine were killed in the collision but Sato's sacrifice enabled Ezra Bridger and Chopper to escape offworld aboard the [[Nightbrother (Gauntlet fighter)|''Gauntlet'']] to seek help.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

===Legacy===
Commander Sato's sacrifice was not in vain, as it allowed Ezra and Chopper to seek help from Sabine and [[Clan Wren]] on [[Krownest]] to take down the second Interdictor cruiser. Because of the reinforcements, the remainders of Phoenix Squadron and the Massassi Group were able to escape Thrawn's blockade and arrive on [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Zero Hour" /> Sato was buried there, near the ancient temples of the [[Massassi Site]], a black gravestone marking his final resting place.<ref name="Never Far Behind" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I will not abandon our command ship!|Commander Sato, during Darth Vader's attack on the fleet|audio=I_will_not_abandon_ship_TSoL.flac|<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />}}
[[File:Commander_Sato_orders_evacuation.png|thumb|left|300px|Sato was reluctant to abandon ''Phoenix Home'', but ordered its evacuation once its loss was apparent.]]
Jun Sato was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|brown]]-but-greying [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> He was a by-the-books commander,<ref name="Sato Databank" /> operating his cell using military protocols.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> He was grateful that the ''Ghost'' had become part of his fleet<ref name="Sato Databank" /> and felt that the rebels had proven invaluable to the rebellion's cause,<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> though he also believed that the Spectres lacked effective discipline.<ref name="Sato Databank" /> During Darth Vader's assault on the Phoenix fleet, Sato at first refused to allow his crew to abandon ''Phoenix Home'', as he was unwilling to lose his own command ship. Once he realized that the ship was lost, however, he regretfully agreed with Captain Syndulla's advice to order his crew to evacuate the ship.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" />

Sato was a strategist who realized the importance of the rebellion in winning new recruits,<ref name="Antilles Extraction" /> new starships,<ref name="Wings" /> and finding a base.<ref name="The Forgotten Droid" /> He was a courageous commander even in the face of adversity. When captured by [[Admiral]] [[Brom Titus]], Sato was not afraid and tried to intimidate the Admiral by claiming that he and his crew were members of the [[Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> Sato realized that Ezra Bridger had good leadership potential and promoted the youth to [[Lieutenant Commander]] following a successful prison heist on Naraka. However, Sato overlooked Ezra's aggressive streak and brush with the [[dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Steps" />

Sato had a brother and a nephew named Mart Mattin. After losing his brother, Sato thought he had lost his family until Hera encountered Mart during a mission to Mykapo. Sato was determined to do anything to reunite with his nephew. He was grateful to Hera and her crew for risking their lives to save Mart. Sato regarded Mart as stubborn and rebellious but still loved his nephew. The two happily embraced each other during their reunion at Chopper Base.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

Sato was ready to lay down his life for the rebellion. Sato sacrificed his life by ramming his command ship ''Phoenix Home'' into an interdictor cruiser. His sacrifice enabled Ezra and Chopper to escape and seek reinforcements offworld.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Skills and abilities==
Sato was a talented leader and battle strategist. He was also highly skilled at diplomacy and playing [[sabacc]]<ref name="Epic Battles">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Jun Sato was a character created for the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Fire Recon">{{RebelsRecon|xggYEpemcck|#1.14: Inside "Fire Across the Galaxy" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-fire-across-the-galaxy}}</ref> He made his first appearance in ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'',<ref name="The Siege of Lothal" /> the television movie that kicked off the show's second season, in which he was voiced by [[Keone Young]].<ref name="Siege Premiere">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-season-two-set-to-premiere-june-20|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Two Set to Premiere June 20}}</ref> The character was first revealed in [[Rebels Recon]], a behind the scenes video series hosted on [[StarWars.com]], for the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] finale "[[Fire Across the Galaxy]]." The video provided concept art for Commander Sato, as well as for Phoenix Squadron and the entire Phoenix rebel cell.<ref name="Fire Recon" />

His name is derived from Japanese film director [[Wikipedia:Jun Fukuda|Jun Fukuda]] and composer [[Wikipedia:Masaru Sato|Masaru Sato]], who worked together on the Godzilla series, including [[Dave Filoni]]'s favorite film, [[Wikipedia:Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla|''Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla'']].<ref>[http://www.tohokingdom.com/media/podcast.htm Toho Kingdom Podcast, 3/4/2015], around 33 minute mark</ref>

In the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', Jun Sato's surname is misspelled as "Soto."<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>
